intro: Lumin Bed blends functionality with contemporary luxury. Defined by its expansive headboard, pristine white finish, and integrated conveniences, it transforms the bedroom into a sophisticated retreat.

features.title: Pristine white finish for contemporary elegance
features.text: Finished entirely in premium white PU, Lumin creates a clean and seamless visual presence. The smooth surface reflects light softly, enhancing the sense of openness and sophistication within the bedroom.

features.title: Extended headboard for a grand visual statement
features.text: The generously proportioned headboard extends beyond the width of the bed, creating a striking architectural feature. This expansive design anchors the room while adding a luxurious sense of scale.

features.title: Integrated side storage for everyday convenience
features.text: Concealed storage compartments built into the extended headboard keep essentials organised and within easy reach. The hidden design maintains the bed's uncluttered and refined appearance.

features.title: Built-in charging ports for connected living
features.text: Integrated USB and Type-C charging ports allow devices to remain powered without the need for additional adapters or extension cords. This thoughtful feature supports modern lifestyles with effortless convenience.

features.title: Integrated induction charging for a clutter-free look
features.text: Dedicated induction charging dock enables devices to charge seamlessly without wires and cables, for a clutter free look. This intelligent design preserves the bed's clean aesthetic.

features.title: Open display niches for personalised styling
features.text: The extended headboard incorporates open display spaces that provide a dedicated area for décor accents, books, or personal essentials, adding character to the bedroom setting.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
